insight.question: Which provider has the highest appeal volume and what is its overturn rate?
insight._sql:
-- q1: Which provider has the highest appeal volume and what is its overturn rate?
SELECT `Provider_ID` AS `Provider ID`, `Provider_Name` AS `Provider Name`, COUNT(`Case Identifier`) AS `Total Appeals`, SUM(CASE WHEN `Determination` IN ('OVERTURNED','PARTIALLY OVERTURNED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Overturned Cases`, SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Closed Cases`, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN `Determination` IN ('OVERTURNED','PARTIALLY OVERTURNED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0), 2) END AS `Overturn Rate` FROM `my_catalog`.`default`.`appeals_final` GROUP BY `Provider_ID`, `Provider_Name` ORDER BY `Total Appeals` DESC, `Provider_ID` ASC LIMIT 1

insight.question: Which operational unit has the best TAT performance?
insight._sql:
-- q1: Which operational unit has the best TAT performance?
SELECT `Current Unit Name`, AVG(DATEDIFF(`Closed Date (CaseHistory)`, `Received Date`)) AS `Avg Turnaround Days` FROM `my_catalog`.`default`.`appeals_final` WHERE `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' GROUP BY `Current Unit Name` ORDER BY `Avg Turnaround Days` ASC, `Current Unit Name` ASC LIMIT 1
